card.name: Small words in Colorado-region text
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, the, in, to, from, commas) in web text about Colorado, Denver and the Rocky Mountain West, just before a place name or tribe name.

modes.label: Before Colorado place names
modes.description: Words like of, the, in or from just before a Colorado or Denver-area place name.

card.writes: It pushes up mountain and Rocky Mountain-region words such as Colo and Rocky, and pushes down Midwest names like Indiana, Illinois and Chicago.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words in Colorado and Rocky Mountain text, when a regional place name is likely next.
